description: An MP's or peer's career in Parliament: seats held, party changes, ministerial and shadow posts, other posts and select committee memberships, each with start and end dates, from the UK Parliament Members API. Answers "was X ever a minister?" or "what committees has X sat on?" for journalists, researchers and public affairs. Covers parliamentary roles only, not careers outside Parliament. (cost: 1 credit)

memberId.description: integer, required, Parliament member id (from mp_lookup or constituency_search)

name: member_career_history
